capture_source: live capture 2026-11-25: RFC_READ_TABLE on T100 (field TEXT, SAP standard message texts) with USE_ET_DATA_4_RETURN='X', kernel 793, release 758, Unicode. Rows selected for '&', '<', '>', '"', "'" and a German umlaut.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. 'item_hex' is one <item> element of the ET_DATA document exactly as the server sent it; 'value' is the LINE text the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) returned for that row, which saprfclib returned too. The server escapes & < > " ' as decimal character references (& < > " ') and sends other characters as raw UTF-8 (ä = c3 a4); no named entity, no hexadecimal or zero-padded reference was seen.
